name: Consett Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at St Paul's Church. Open Mon and Thu for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Consett Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Blackhill Park. Grows vegetables and soft fruits with harvest shared among volunteers. Focus on heritage varieties suitable for the North East.
